maison.title: The YoLi House
maison.intro: Born in Abidjan, YoLi is a fashion and lifestyle house that celebrates everyday elegance. Four worlds, one signature: the art of being you.

histoire.title: One house, four worlds
histoire.p1: YoLi is a fashion and lifestyle house founded in Cote d'Ivoire. It brings together carefully designed feminine creations, signature fragrances, a selection of jewelry and accessories, and an imported menswear collection chosen piece by piece.
histoire.p2: Every world shares the same standard: to offer the very best, in the precision of detail and the sincerity of the gesture. YoLi dresses those who see elegance as a way of being, never as a statement.

vision.title: Luxury, quietly
vision.p1: We believe in quiet luxury: elegance in presentation, simplicity in experience. No excess, but attention paid to the essential, from the chosen material to the care of the service.
vision.p2: YoLi cultivates a pared-back, warm aesthetic where every piece has its reason to be. It is the art of being you, revealed effortlessly.

sections.heading: Zones and timeframes
sections.body: We deliver throughout Abidjan within 3 to 5 business days. For the rest of Cote d'Ivoire, allow 5 to 8 business days. International deliveries are handled case by case; contact us for a quote.

sections.heading: Shipping fees
sections.body: Shipping fees are calculated based on your address and the chosen method, and shown before you confirm your order. Shipping is free in Abidjan on orders over 150,000 FCFA.

sections.heading: Order tracking
sections.body: As soon as your order ships, you receive a confirmation by email or message. Our team remains available to track your parcel at every step.

sections.heading: Delivery methods
sections.body: You may choose home delivery or pickup-point collection at checkout. An appointment can be arranged for designer pieces and made-to-measure orders.

sections.heading: Return window
sections.body: You have 14 days after delivery to request a return or exchange. Items must be returned as new, unworn, with their tags and original packaging.

sections.heading: Non-returnable items
sections.body: For hygiene reasons, opened fragrances, pierced jewelry and personalized or made-to-measure items cannot be returned or exchanged, unless a defect is found.

sections.heading: How to proceed
sections.body: Contact us by email or phone with your order number. We will send you the return or exchange instructions within 48 hours.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: After we receive and check the item, refunds are issued within 7 to 10 business days to the original payment method, or as store credit depending on your preference.

items.a: In Abidjan, allow 3 to 5 business days. For the rest of the country, 5 to 8 business days. Timeframes are confirmed at checkout.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?

items.q: How do I choose my size?
items.a: A size guide is available on every product page. If in doubt, our team is happy to advise you by email or phone.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms and conditions of sale govern sales of products offered by YoLi on its website. Any order implies full and complete acceptance of these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Products and prices
sections.body: Products are presented with the utmost care. Prices are shown in CFA francs (FCFA), all taxes included. YoLi reserves the right to change its prices at any time, products being invoiced at the rate in force at the time of the order.

sections.heading: 3. Orders
sections.body: An order is confirmed once the customer validates it and payment is accepted. YoLi reserves the right to cancel any order in the event of a dispute, unavailability or payment issue.

sections.heading: 4. Payment
sections.body: Payment is made via Wave, Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money or bank card. The order is processed only after payment confirmation.

sections.heading: 5. Delivery
sections.body: Delivery timeframes and fees are specified at checkout. YoLi cannot be held liable for delays attributable to the carrier or to a force majeure event.

sections.heading: 6. Right of withdrawal
sections.body: In accordance with our policy, you have 14 days to return an item under the conditions set out on our Returns & Exchanges page.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: We collect the information needed to process your orders and manage the customer relationship: name, contact details, delivery address and purchase history. This data is strictly confidential.

sections.heading: Use of data
sections.body: Your data is used to process your orders, to inform you of our new arrivals if you have consented, and to improve your experience. It is never sold to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Our site uses cookies essential to the proper functioning of the cart and your session. Analytics cookies are only placed with your consent.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, write to us at akassirosemira@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Site publisher
sections.body: This site is published by YoLi, a fashion and lifestyle house based in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire. Contact: akassirosemira@gmail.com - 07 68 14 15 34.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on the site (text, visuals, logos, creations) is the exclusive property of YoLi. Any reproduction, in whole or in part, is prohibited without prior authorization.

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.body: The site is hosted by a provider ensuring the availability and security of data. The host's details are available on request.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: YoLi strives to ensure the accuracy of the information published. YoLi cannot be held liable for any error, omission or temporary unavailability of the site.
